_about: CC0 scans used only for fine grain (Track E2). fetch_sources.py downloads them to the git-ignored Data/BuildMat/raw/<id>/. Every one is CC0: free for commercial use, no credit required (credited in docs/envloop/buildmat anyway). width_m is the real width the scan covers (Poly Haven's listed dimensions; ambientCG's plaster is taken as 2 m).

brickface.use: fired face grain and pits of every brick

stone.use: chopped face of the limestone veneer

wood.use: wood grain embossed in fibre-cement siding and battens

metal.use: paint skin and roll marks on the steel roof
